assets.name: storm-clouds
assets.prompt:
Original hand-painted dark undead fantasy atmosphere asset. Economical broad brush strokes, soft lost edges, deep charcoal / desaturated blue-green / pale cold grey, matching the reference painting. No scenery, buildings, figures, faces, bones, lettering, labels, checkerboard, watermark, border or baked lightning. Genuine transparent RGBA background with naturally fading alpha.
Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY. Generate entirely NEW shapes; do not crop, trace or reproduce its existing cloud details.
Create ONE square 2x2 sprite atlas of FOUR distinctly different horizontal storm-cloud formations. Four equal cells, no visible grid. Top-left: long heavy layered cloud bank. Top-right: broad low rolling cloud with open broken edges. Bottom-left: thinner trailing cloud ribbons grouped into one loose bank. Bottom-right: a dark looming cumuliform bank with subtle grey-green top light. Every cloud fits wholly inside its own cell, with at least 12 percent transparent padding on all four sides. Cloud silhouette about70percent cell width and40percent cell height. Avoid identical shapes or repeated curls. Dim restrained lighting, darker cores, semi-transparent outer vapour. Intended for slow independent movement over a dark game sky, not cartoon white puffs. Square canvas approximately1536x1536.
